title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with the band in top form, highlighted by a soaring Let It Grow and tight Truckin'.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, “sick” sound quality, indicating a high‑grade soundboard source. The show itself is described as energetic and “in the zone,” with fans singling out Let It Grow and a clean version of Truckin' as standouts, making it a solid addition to any rotation.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are 4–5 stars and uniformly praise both the musical performance and audio fidelity; the weighted average yields a rating well above 4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the sound “sick,” “great,” and “awesome,” with no complaints about drop‑outs, muddiness, or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list is regarded as solid and enjoyable; one reviewer notes it isn’t the absolute best but still a good representation of the era.
